text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government has sacked the managing director of Zambia's largest bank, the state-run Zambia National Commercial Bank, finance minister Ronald Penza said on Sunday. He did not give any reasons.
- President Frederick Chiluba on Monday leaves for Kenya to attend the second Great Lakes summit on the crisis in eastern Zaire.
- Wildlife scouts have shot dead an elephant which reportedly killed three people in Zambia and neighbouring Zimbabwe in the border town of Livingstone recently.
- The Zambia Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry says the voters' register used in general elections held on November 18 had too many errors.
